text:
Kai: Heads-up from ops — tenant 'nimbus' reporting SCIM duplicates. Provisioner logs show KMS decrypt failures and fallback to username, causing duplicate creates.

Mina: Can you drop the log lines?

Kai: Snippet (sanitized):
```
2026-04-01T11:12:03Z ERROR provisioner: decrypt extid failed: kms.InvalidCiphertextException: ciphertext refers to a different key
  at kms.(*Client).Decrypt
  at provisioner.resolveExternalId
2026-04-01T11:12:03Z WARN provisioner: externalId decrypt failed -> fallback to userName -> created svc-nimbus-reporter-2
```

Oscar: Looks like a rewrap or alias pointed to a different key. infra-bot, any recent KMS alias updates for alias/tenant-extid-nimbus?

infra-bot: KMS event: 2026-04-01T11:10:50Z AliasUpdate alias/tenant-extid-nimbus -> keyId=zzz-333; Key policy changed: added principal arn:aws:iam::555666777:role/partner-sync (statement index 2).

Mina: That partner principal being added is unexpected. Could be OK if only Encrypt allowed, but if Decrypt/ReEncrypt allowed that's exposure. Kai, pause SCIM for nimbus now?

Kai: Pausing inbound provisioning for tenant nimbus via controlplane toggle.

security-bot: Incident created: SEC-2026-061 "SCIM duplicates after KMS alias update + unexpected principal" https://redwood.incidents/SEC-2026-061

Oscar: Short term mitigations: 1) rollback alias to previous key OR remove partner principal; 2) run dry-run rewrap to canonical key and preserve encryption context; 3) add audit shim so we record attempted deprovision with ciphertext-hash when decrypt fails.

Mina: I'm going to revert the key policy to remove partner role and re-add provisioner role. Will post diff.

Mina: Policy diff (sanitized): - removed arn:aws:iam::555666777:role/partner-sync + ensured arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/provisioner present for Decrypt/ReEncrypt.

infra-bot: Policy updated at 2026-04-01T11:22:11Z. Post-update: 0 Decrypt calls from partner role.

Kai: After policy fix, what's safe rewrap approach? Concern: encryption context mismatch can still cause InvalidCiphertext.

Oscar: Use KMS ReEncrypt server-side and set DestinationEncryptionContext to {"tenant":"nimbus","purpose":"extid"} and verify for a small sample. Command: `aws kms re-encrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct.blob --destination-key-id <key> --destination-encryption-context '{"tenant":"nimbus","purpose":"extid"}'`

Mina: Also we should ship a quick provisioner patch: before decrypt attempt write shallow audit row (ciphertext_hmac) and, on decrypt failure, skip blindly creating a new user and instead escalate to dedupe queue. I'll open PR.

Kai: Good. I'm coordinating with CS to inform customer we paused provisioning and are rewrapping; suggested text approved by legal: "We detected a configuration change in an internal key used to protect tenant identifiers which briefly caused provisioning failures. We paused provisioning, reverted the key policy, and are rewrapping identifiers. No confirmed data access by third parties at this time."

security-bot: Update SEC-2026-061: policy rollback done, dry-run rewrap queued.

Mina: Dry-run started (sample=30) at 2026-04-01T11:40Z. Will report results.

Kai: Thanks — post results here and keep oncall-bot notified if anything flares. :white_check_mark:
